name.la: In primam partem Samuhelis libri IV
name.en-US: On the First Part of Samuel
name.pt-BR: Sobre a Primeira Parte de Samuel

description.la: Allegorica expositio in primam partem Samuhelis, libri quattuor, usque ad mortem Saulis.
description.en-US: Bede's four-book allegorical commentary on 1 Samuel, from Hannah's prayer to the death of Saul. Latin text of Migne (PL 91-93); no public-domain English translation is known.
description.pt-BR: O comentário alegórico de Beda, em quatro livros, ao Primeiro Livro de Samuel, da oração de Ana à morte de Saul.

sources.edition: Allegorica expositio in Samuelem on Latin Wikisource, from the Corpus Corporum TEI of Migne's Patrologia Latina.
sources.description: Wikitext removed; inline PL column numbers dropped; one file per book (or per part), chapter divisions kept as headings with their rubrics.
sources.tierEvidence: Eighth-century text in Migne's reprint of Giles: public domain.
